# Load libraries
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggtree)
library(ade4)
```

# Load data

Set paths to data directory and output directory
```{r}
data_path = "path/to/data"

output_path  = "path/to/save/outputs"
```

```{r}
esviritu_res <- fread(paste0(data_path, "Esviritu_HostDiseaseGenometypeV5.tsv")) %>%
  rename(sample_ID = sample_id)

esviritu_res_human <- esviritu_res %>% 
  filter(host_species == "Homo sapiens")

sample_metadata <- read.csv(paste0(data_path, "samples_metadata.csv"), sep=";", dec=",")
```


# TAX TREE FOR ALL DETECTED VIRUSES
## Hierarchical tax table for each detected species

```{r}
tax_hierarchy <- esviritu_res %>%
  distinct(species, genus, family, order, tclass, phylum) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(species = gsub("\\W+", "", species)) %>%
  mutate(genus = gsub("\\W+", "", genus)) %>%
  mutate(family = gsub("\\W+", "", family)) %>%
  mutate(order = gsub("\\W+", "", order)) %>%
  mutate(tclass = gsub("\\W+", "", tclass)) %>%
  mutate(phylum = gsub("\\W+", "", phylum))
``` 

```{r}
tax_hierarchy_df <- as.data.frame(tax_hierarchy)


tax_hierarchy_df <- as.data.frame(unclass(tax_hierarchy_df),
                                 stringsAsFactors=TRUE,
                                 row.names = "species")

cols <- colnames(tax_hierarchy_df)

taxo_phylo <- taxo2phylog(as.taxo(tax_hierarchy_df))
```

Group RPKMF by sample_ID/species
```{r}
species_meta_dt <- merge(esviritu_res, sample_metadata,
                         by = "sample_ID") %>%
  group_by(Year_cat) %>%
  mutate(total_samples = n_distinct(sample_ID)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(species, Year_cat, total_samples) %>%
  summarize(n = n_distinct(sample_ID)) %>%
  mutate(freq = n / total_samples) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  complete(nesting(Year_cat, total_samples), species,
           fill=list(n=0, freq=0))

freq_info_dt <- species_meta_dt %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  mutate(total_number = sum(n),
         h_freq = freq/ sum(freq)) %>%
  filter(Year_cat=="2024-2025") %>%
  select(species, total_number, h_freq) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(species = gsub("\\W+", "", species)) 

```

```{r, warning=FALSE}
tree_all <- ggtree::ggtree(taxo_phylo, layout = "daylight",branch.length = "scaled",
             color="grey40", size=0.2)

```

```{r}
freq_info_dt$total_number <- as.numeric(freq_info_dt$total_number)
```

Family level annotations based on these:
geom_text(aes(label=node))
View(tree_all@data)


# TAX TREE FOR HUMAN VIRUSES
## Hierarchical tax table for each detected species

```{r}
tax_hierarchy_h <- esviritu_res_human %>%
  distinct(species, genus, family,
           order, tclass, phylum) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(species = gsub("\\W+", "", species)) %>%
  mutate(genus = gsub("\\W+", "", genus)) %>%
  mutate(family = gsub("\\W+", "", family)) %>%
  mutate(order = gsub("\\W+", "", order)) %>%
  mutate(tclass = gsub("\\W+", "", tclass)) %>%
  mutate(phylum = gsub("\\W+", "", phylum))
``` 

```{r}
tax_hierarchy_h_df <- as.data.frame(tax_hierarchy_h)

                                 stringsAsFactors=TRUE,
                                 row.names = "species")

cols <- colnames(tax_hierarchy_h_df)

taxo_phylo_h <- taxo2phylog(as.taxo(tax_hierarchy_h_df))
```

Get the family clade numbers and annotations for plot annotation

```{r}
get_clade_annot_commands <- function(tax.phy_obj, search_data, tax_tree_data){
  #get the family nodes
  third_nodes <- sapply(tax.phy_obj$paths, function(path) {
  if (length(path) >= 5) path[5] else NA
  })

  #use only the nodes with s__ on the name
  third_nodes_idx <- grep("s__", names(third_nodes))
  #third_nodes <- na.omit(third_nodes)
  #return(((third_nodes[third_nodes_idx])))
  clade_commands <- sapply(seq_along(third_nodes[third_nodes_idx]), function(i) {
    f_node_num <- tree_h@data[tree_h@data$label == unname(third_nodes[i]), "node"]
    node_label <- unique(search_data[search_data$species == names(third_nodes[i]), "family"])
    paste0("geom_cladelab(node = ", f_node_num, 
           ", label = '", node_label, 
           "', fontsize = 8) +")
  })

  clade_commands <- unique(clade_commands)
  all_clades <- paste(clade_commands, collapse="\n")
  return(all_clades)
}
```

```{r}
#create a search table from esviritu results
species_family_df <- esviritu_res[, c("family", "species")] %>%
  mutate(family=gsub("f__", "", family),
         species = gsub("\\W+", "", species))

annots <- get_clade_annot_commands(taxo_phylo_h, species_family_df, tree_h)

(cat(annots))

```
